note: The planned Marswalk. The habitat position is an assumption: no landing site has been chosen here. It is the flattest 40 m patch in the elevation crop (largest slope 4.1 degrees). The stops are places where Curiosity itself worked, taken from NASA's waypoint file.

habitat.name: Habitat
habitat.text: Assumed start and end of the walk. Chosen as the flattest 40 m patch near the boxwork.

stops.name: Altadena drill site
stops.text: Curiosity drilled its first boxwork-region sample, a rock nicknamed Altadena, here on 8 June 2025.

stops.name: Ridge and hollow drill site
stops.text: In late 2025 Curiosity drilled a hollow here (Valle de la Luna) and then the ridge about 10 m away (Nevado Sajama), to compare the two. It worked within about 20 m of this spot from sol 4687 to sol 4805.

stops.name: Unvisited ground, west bench
stops.text: Ground about 500 m west of the ridges that Curiosity did not drive to. Provisional target: steep slopes lie between it and the rover's path.
